summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Ardagh Metal Packaging S.A. furnishing its unaudited interim financial statements for Q1 2026. The filing contains standard quarterly results—revenue, cost of sales, operating profit, net finance expense, and loss per share—along with notes and management discussion. There is no mention of any M&A, tender offer, restructuring, activist campaign, or other corporate event. The filing is an ordinary periodic report under the 1934 Act, not a special situation.
